description: List the 462 country and world-region codes recognized by the UNESCO Institute for Statistics Data API, optionally filtered by name or level (NATIONAL/REGIONAL). Use this to find a valid geo_unit code for unesco-data.get_data. Example: query='Kenya'. Data: api.uis.unesco.org, no auth required, CC BY-SA 4.0.

query.description: Case-insensitive substring to match against country/region name, e.g. 'Kenya' or 'Africa'.

type.description: Filter to one geo unit level: NATIONAL (countries) or REGIONAL (world regions).

name: unesco-data.reference.geounit_list

error.description: Present only when the call failed. Includes error code, message, request_id, and any provider-specific extras.

result.description: Tool response payload. Shape varies per tool — consult the tool description and inputSchema. May be an object, array, string, or number depending on the upstream provider response.

title: UNESCO UIS Geo Unit List
